xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:AnyOtherInformationForDisclosu: The Bank had submitted Integrated Financial Results for September 30, 2025, including RPT disclosures, to NSE on November 06, 2025, i.e. on the same day of publication of the said Results, assuming the filing would auto propagate to BSE, like other integrated submissions. Thereafter on the advise of the BSE, the Bank submitted the XBRL file to BSE as well.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NatureAndDetailsOfTheActionTak:
The Bank had submitted the Financial Results (Integrated Filing – Financial for Banking) including the disclosure pertaining to the Related Party Transactions pursuant to Regulation 23(9) of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulation, 2025 ("SEBI Listing Regulations") as part of the said XBRL format only with the National Stock Exchange of India on November 06, 2025, i.e. the date when these were approved, with an understanding that once submitted to one of Exchanges, the same would be automatically propagated to another Exchange, i.e. BSE Limited. However, based on advise of BSE Limited, these were submitted to BSE Limited after 7 days of the Board meeting.
Thereafter, pursuant to SEBI Master Circular No. SEBI/HO/CFD/PoD2/CIR/P/0155 dated November 11, 2024, BSE Limited sent an email to the Bank on December 16, 2025, advising for making payment of fine amounting Rs. 35,000 (+GST) towards delayed submission of disclosure of related party transactions along with the Financial Results in XBRL format to BSE Limited pursuant to Regulation 23(9) of SEBI Listing Regulations for the half year ended September 30, 2025. The Bank requested for a waiver mentioning that the submission was made to NSE Limited with an understanding that once submitted to one of Exchanges, the same would be automatically propagated to another Exchange, i.e. BSE Limited, however it was denied by BSE Limited. Accordingly, the Bank has paid the amount of fine on December 29, 2025 (i.e. within 15 days as had been advised by BSE Limited).
